<template>
  <view class="order-page">
    <view class="order-summary">
      <view class="summary-copy">
        <text class="summary-title">我的订单</text>
        <text class="summary-subtitle">物流状态会实时更新</text>
      </view>
      <view class="socket-state" wx:class="{{ {online: logisticsOnline} }}">
        <view class="state-dot"></view>
        <text>{{logisticsOnline ? '实时物流已连接' : '实时物流连接中'}}</text>
      </view>
    </view>

    <view class="status-tabs">
      <view
        class="status-tab"
        wx:for="{{statusTabs}}"
        wx:key="key"
        wx:class="{{ {active: item.key === activeStatus} }}"
        bindtap="switchStatus(item.key)"
      >
        <text>{{item.label}}</text>
        <text wx:if="{{item.count}}" class="status-count">{{item.count}}</text>
      </view>
    </view>

    <view class="order-list">
      <swipe-order-item
        wx:for="{{orders}}"
        wx:key="id"
        order="{{item}}"
        disabled="{{item.locked}}"
        bindselect="openOrder"
        bindremove="removeOrder"
        bindswipeend="handleSwipeEnd"
      />
    </view>

    <view wx:if="{{loading}}" class="order-loading">
      <text>订单加载中...</text>
    </view>
    <view wx:elif="{{!orders.length}}" class="order-empty">
      <text>当前没有订单</text>
      <button class="shopping-button" bindtap="goShopping">去逛逛</button>
    </view>

    <logistics-channel
      wx:if="{{memberId}}"
      memberId="{{memberId}}"
      bindconnectedchange="handleConnectionChange"
      bindlogistics="handleLogisticsMessage"
      binderror="handleChannelError"
    />
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'

createPage({
  data: {
    memberId: 'member-10086',
    activeStatus: 'all',
    statusTabs: [
      { key: 'all', label: '全部', count: 0 },
      { key: 'paying', label: '待付款', count: 1 },
      { key: 'shipping', label: '待收货', count: 2 },
      { key: 'done', label: '已完成', count: 0 }
    ],
    orders: [
      {
        id: 'order-20260812001',
        orderNo: '20260812001',
        status: 'shipping',
        statusText: '运输中',
        logisticsText: '包裹已到达上海转运中心',
        updatedAt: '今天 10:26',
        cover: '/assets/orders/blueberry.png',
        title: '云南高山蓝莓 4 盒装',
        skuText: '125g × 4 盒',
        amount: '39.90',
        count: 1,
        locked: false
      },
      {
        id: 'order-20260811008',
        orderNo: '20260811008',
        status: 'shipping',
        statusText: '已揽收',
        logisticsText: '快递员已揽收',
        updatedAt: '昨天 18:42',
        cover: '/assets/orders/coffee.png',
        title: '便携式手冲咖啡套装',
        skuText: '黑色 · 标准版',
        amount: '129.00',
        count: 1,
        locked: false
      }
    ],
    logisticsOnline: false,
    loading: false
  },
  methods: {
    switchStatus (status) {
      if (status === this.activeStatus) return
      this.activeStatus = status
      this.fetchOrders()
    },
    fetchOrders () {
      this.loading = true
      wx.request({
        url: '/api/orders',
        data: { status: this.activeStatus },
        success: ({ data }) => {
          this.orders = data.list
          this.statusTabs = data.summary
        },
        complete: () => {
          this.loading = false
        }
      })
    },
    openOrder ({ detail }) {
      wx.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/orders/detail?id=${detail.orderId}` })
    },
    removeOrder ({ detail }) {
      wx.showModal({
        title: '删除订单',
        content: '删除后将无法在订单列表中查看，确认删除吗？',
        success: ({ confirm }) => {
          if (!confirm) return
          wx.request({
            url: `/api/orders/${detail.orderId}`,
            method: 'DELETE',
            success: () => {
              this.orders = this.orders.filter(order => order.id !== detail.orderId)
            }
          })
        }
      })
    },
    handleSwipeEnd ({ detail }) {
      if (!detail.open) return
      this.orders = this.orders.map(order => {
        return Object.assign({}, order, { locked: order.id !== detail.orderId })
      })
    },
    handleConnectionChange ({ detail }) {
      this.logisticsOnline = detail.connected
    },
    handleLogisticsMessage ({ detail }) {
      this.orders = this.orders.map(order => {
        if (order.id !== detail.orderId) return order
        return Object.assign({}, order, {
          status: detail.status,
          statusText: detail.statusText,
          logisticsText: detail.logisticsText,
          updatedAt: detail.updatedAt
        })
      })
    },
    handleChannelError () {
      this.logisticsOnline = false
    },
    goShopping () {
      wx.switchTab({ url: '/pages/home/index' })
    }
  }
})
</script>

<script module="gesture" lang="wxs">
var startX = 0
var currentOffset = 0

function pointX(event) {
  var touches = event.touches && event.touches.length ? event.touches : event.changedTouches
  return touches && touches.length ? touches[0].clientX : 0
}

module.exports = {
  onTouchStart: function (event) {
    if (event.currentTarget.dataset.disabled) return
    startX = pointX(event)
    currentOffset = 0
    event.instance.callMethod('beginSwipe')
  },
  onTouchMove: function (event) {
    if (event.currentTarget.dataset.disabled) return
    currentOffset = pointX(event) - startX
    if (currentOffset > 0) currentOffset = 0
    if (currentOffset < -96) currentOffset = -96
    event.instance.callMethod('syncSwipeOffset', currentOffset)
  },
  onTouchEnd: function (event) {
    if (event.currentTarget.dataset.disabled) return
    event.instance.callMethod('finishSwipe', currentOffset <= -48)
  },
  onTouchCancel: function (event) {
    if (event.currentTarget.dataset.disabled) return
    currentOffset = 0
    event.instance.callMethod('cancelSwipe')
  }
}
</script>

<script>
import { createComponent } from '@mpxjs/core'

createComponent({
  properties: {
    order: {
      type: Object,
      value: () => ({})
    },
    disabled: Boolean
  },
  data: {
    offsetX: 0
  },
  methods: {
    beginSwipe () {
      this.triggerEvent('swipestart', { orderId: this.order.id })
    },
    syncSwipeOffset (offsetX) {
      this.offsetX = offsetX
    },
    finishSwipe (open) {
      this.offsetX = open ? -96 : 0
      this.triggerEvent('swipeend', { orderId: this.order.id, open })
    },
    cancelSwipe () {
      this.offsetX = 0
      this.triggerEvent('swipeend', { orderId: this.order.id, open: false })
    },
    selectOrder () {
      if (this.disabled) return
      this.triggerEvent('select', { orderId: this.order.id })
    },
    removeOrder () {
      if (this.disabled) return
      this.triggerEvent('remove', { orderId: this.order.id })
    }
  }
})

    </view>

      <button class="ping-button" bindtap="sendHeartbeat">检测连接</button>
    </view>
  </view>

<script>
import { createComponent } from '@mpxjs/core'

createComponent({
  properties: {
    memberId: {
      type: String,
      observer () {
        this.connectChannel()
      }
    }
  },
  data: {
    connected: false
  },
  attached () {
    this.connectChannel()
  },
  detached () {
    wx.closeSocket()
  },
  methods: {
    connectChannel () {
      if (!this.memberId) return
      wx.connectSocket({
        url: `wss://logistics.example.com/members/${this.memberId}`,
        header: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${wx.getStorageSync('token')}`
        }
      })
      wx.onSocketOpen(() => {
        this.connected = true
        this.triggerEvent('connectedchange', { connected: true })
      })
      wx.onSocketMessage(({ data }) => {
        const message = JSON.parse(data)
        if (message.type === 'logistics') {
          this.triggerEvent('logistics', message.payload)
        }
      })
      wx.onSocketError((error) => {
        this.connected = false
        this.triggerEvent('connectedchange', { connected: false })
        this.triggerEvent('error', { error })
      })
      wx.onSocketClose(() => {
        this.connected = false
        this.triggerEvent('connectedchange', { connected: false })
      })
    },
    reconnect () {
      wx.closeSocket()
      this.connectChannel()
    },
    sendHeartbeat () {
      wx.sendSocketMessage({
        data: JSON.stringify({ type: 'ping', memberId: this.memberId })
      })
    }
  }
})
</script>

var MAX_OFFSET = 96
var OPEN_THRESHOLD = 48
var states = {}

function pointX(event) {
  var touches = event.touches && event.touches.length ? event.touches : event.changedTouches
  return touches && touches.length ? touches[0].clientX : 0
}

  return value === true || value === 'true' || value === 1 || value === '1'
}

  onTouchStart: function (event) {
    if (isDisabled(event)) return

  onTouchMove: function (event) {

  onTouchEnd: function (event) {

  onTouchCancel: function (event) {
    if (isDisabled(event)) return
    var state = stateFor(event)
    state.offset = 0

<script>
import { createComponent } from '@mpxjs/core'

createComponent({
  properties: {
    memberId: {
      type: String,
      observer () {
        this.connectChannel()
      }
    }
  },
  data: {
    connected: false,
    channelGeneration: 0,
    socketTask: null
  },
  attached () {
    this.connectChannel()
  },
    detached () {
      this.invalidateChannel()
    },
    methods: {
    invalidateChannel () {
      this.channelGeneration += 1
      this.connected = false
      if (this.socketTask && this.socketTask.close) this.socketTask.close()
      else if (wx.closeSocket) wx.closeSocket()
      this.socketTask = null
    },
    connectChannel () {
      if (!this.memberId) return
      this.invalidateChannel()
      var generation = this.channelGeneration
      var memberId = this.memberId
      var socketTask = wx.connectSocket({
        url: `wss://logistics.example.com/members/${memberId}`,
        header: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${wx.getStorageSync('token')}`
        }
      })
      this.socketTask = socketTask
      var active = () => this.channelGeneration === generation && this.memberId === memberId
      var onOpen = () => {
        if (!active()) return
        this.connected = true
        this.triggerEvent('connectedchange', { connected: true })
      }
      var onMessage = ({ data }) => {
        if (!active()) return
        var message
        try { message = typeof data === 'string' ? JSON.parse(data) : data } catch (error) { return }
        if (message.type === 'logistics') {
          var payload = message.payload || {}
          if (!payload.memberId || payload.memberId === memberId) {
            this.triggerEvent('logistics', Object.assign({}, payload, { memberId }))
          }
        }
      }
      var onError = (error) => {
        if (!active()) return
        this.connected = false
        this.triggerEvent('connectedchange', { connected: false })
        this.triggerEvent('error', { error })
      }
      var onClose = () => {
        if (!active()) return
        this.connected = false
        this.triggerEvent('connectedchange', { connected: false })
      }
      if (socketTask && socketTask.onOpen) {
        socketTask.onOpen(onOpen)
        socketTask.onMessage(onMessage)
        socketTask.onError(onError)
        socketTask.onClose(onClose)
      } else {
        wx.onSocketOpen(onOpen)
        wx.onSocketMessage(onMessage)
        wx.onSocketError(onError)
        wx.onSocketClose(onClose)
      }
    },
    reconnect () {
      this.connectChannel()
    },
    sendHeartbeat () {
      wx.sendSocketMessage({
        data: JSON.stringify({ type: 'ping', memberId: this.memberId }),
        fail: () => {}
      })
    }
  }
})
</script>
